author: Dale Roberts
title: Well, let's not mess around - let's get to the good stuff. H
text:
Well, let's not mess around - let's get to the good stuff. Here are the returns for Apple ( AAPL ) and BlackRock ( BLK ) for 2017. As always past performance does not guarantee future returns. The returns are courtesy of portfoliovisualizer.com. The portfolio is weighted in the approximate weighting that the two companies hold in my retirement portfolio account, 60% Apple and 40% BlackRock. Portfolio 1 is the Apple/BlackRock duo for calendar year 2017.


And here are the individual returns of the two companies.
And here is the individual company performance in chart form for the calendar year 2017. Portfolio 1 is Apple and Portfolio 2 is BlackRock.
These two companies have been delivering on the total return over the last many years. Here are those same two companies from January 2016 through to end of 2017. There was slight alpha delivered in 2016, but it was certainly in 2017 when the market started to show some true love for the recent success and longer term prospects of Apple and BlackRock.
